limitations: Single stationary scene-instance snapshot; no opening sweep is executed by this exporter.
Each collider AABB encloses the physical shape at capture; link motion must be recomposed for future postures.
Disabled colliders are inventoried; future activation changes invalidate the envelope.
Contact offsets and table measurement uncertainty must be added to geometric clearance.
